notes.title: Spindlejack, A Solo Citizen Sleeper TTRPG, Is Available Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238001/7a2c2b51ed56ac78148136b4b3791388d5e2bd6b.png

A free gift as a thank you to the Citizen Sleeper community to celebrate three years of Citizen Sleeper, SPINDLEJACK is a solo TTRPG. Become a Spindlejack (an airbike courier on the Far Spindle), and take shifts to earn Cryo and Rep from the hectic deliveries across the station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238001/49c5cf9c0fb4e56d37ced304bd1596c40c699fb4.jpg
To play, you'll need:

 10 six-sided dice (d6) (3 sets of 3, and 1 extra).
 A pencil or some counters for tracking resources.
 A printed copy of the playsheet and map (supplied via this download as a PDF).

To access the PDFs:

 Right click on Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector in your Steam library and select Manage > Browse Local Files
 Double Click on the PDFs folder
 Open the Spindlejack PDFs

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3718020/Citizen_Sleeper__Spindlejack/

And don't forget, you can get Citizen Sleeper for 70% off and Citizen Sleeper 2 for 20% off until May 14!

notes.title: In Other Waters Turns Five Years Old!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/1c17cd8fb16fc705f515e7b21a83d681fcfc09aa.png

It's unbelievable! Jump Over the Age's debut title, In Other Waters, has turned five years old already! We'd like to take the opportunity to thank everyone who's explored the alien oceans of Gliese 667Cc with Ellery.

To celebrate, Jump Over the Age is partnering with Lost In Cult for a limited edition of some incredible In Other Waters treasures.
In a hurry? Pre-orders are open here!
Now, let's take a look!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/324ffaa729b36aa0fa0a8677b27bef4b369fad79.png
First off is a physical reprint of A Study of Gliese 667Cc - the companion book which acts as both an epilogue to the story of In Other Waters and a partial catalog of some of the life players will discover in their study of the planet. Filled with sketches and paintings of the creatures and planet of Gliese 667Cc by the game’s developer Gareth Damian Martin, it is a window into a beautiful alien world. Previously only available in a limited run for the game’s 2018 Kickstarter, this is a unique opportunity to get a physical copy of this highly sought after book.

Limited Edition of 500 units

 Hardcover book
 New cover art
 100 pages
 280 x 240 mm
 Section sewn binding
 150 gsm premium paper stock


In addition, Lost in Cult is re-releasing the game’s wondrous ambient soundtrack by Amos Roddy on new, limited edition transparent yellow vinyl. Also, for the first time we’re releasing a limited edition cassette on transparent yellow tape. Both vinyl and cassette releases come with all new cover art by Eisner-nominated comic artist Linnea Sterte.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/bd9b72019a3260dc4ad89cc432179f72524a40a8.pngVinyl - Limited Edition of 300 units

 Single LP 12” Vinyl Record
 New cover art by Linnea Sterte
 Pressed on transparent yellow vinyl
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/8a46dda09dc4d08714b5838de7ceb139e86f4386.pngCassette - Limited Edition of 200 units

 C45 Cassette Tape
 Cover art by Linnea Sterte
 Transparent yellow cassette tape with black print
Pre-orders are open NOW and can be found here!

Thanks again to all our players for being a part of this incredible journey. Here's to the next five years!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/890720/In_Other_Waters/

notes.title: JOTA and Makeship Team Up for The Stray Plush!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238001/2d46eacd9b63d445970c9a619c3ecb8c5a6c0a0d.png

Order your Makeship plush of The Stray now!

This cat, the one on your ship, was born here. That much is obvious. It is a creature of zero-gravity, a being that orbits and glides, not one that leaps and stalks. It pats at your hand, encouraging you to continue petting.

Make friends with the Rig’s most important crew member, the Stray! This official plush was designed by Guillaume Singelin, the character designer of Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector.

As a fun bonus behind the design process, here's some of the concept art Guillaume made for the plush:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238001/75796d967427ba3c55574769e1ed46712540d609.png
This zero-g cat will be happy to float in any cushioned corner, features its signature bandage and a pack of liquid rations too, for when it gets hungry.

Just make sure to keep her out of your supplies…

Thanks all for playing Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector,  please leave us a review!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2442460/Citizen_Sleeper_2_Starward_Vector/

notes.title: Citizen Sleeper 2 Demo Goes Live October 14 for a LIMITED TIME
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238001/340b6736fe5bdc2af3100e3604f4dec6fd4a4ce6.png

Big news, Sleeper! A limited-time demo for Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector has just been announced! 
It will ONLY be available during Steam Next Fest (14-21 October)!

During Steam Next Fest, you'll be able to explore Starward Vector's first location. Visit the hostile Hexport, and meet locals both friendly and untrustworthy. Your goal is to repair your ship and escape before you are caught - but will you be able to do so in time?

So make sure to wishlist Citizen Sleeper 2 right now if you haven't already, and you'll be notified the moment the Hexport demo is live. Get ready to assemble your crew and complete your first two contracts!

The Emulated Mind tee, modelled here by Citizen Sleeper creator Gareth Damian Martin features the Sleeper, the stray, and a number of fun references to various cool moments throughout the game. How many can you spot?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/b49edfdbdf5b41f28b8975d3d18bbc6ed6d597ea.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/7f0a584985c312f1f6ac544f68be102deef1eb10.png

Finally, if you're wanting to literally spin that Citizen Sleeper soundtrack IRL, you can pick up a copy of the 'Wake Up, Sleeper' Deluxe Set from our friends at Stumpy Frog Records.

There are plenty more Fellow Traveller titles on sale to choose from - so whether you're looking for something new, a bargain, some cool soundtracks and bundles, or even something to play on Steam Deck, we're sure to have something just for you.

We're also thrilled to announce that three new games are joining the Fellow Traveller family; Scrabdackle, Wander Stars and Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo - read up on each of them below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967820/40c1797b8a73e5d9ffe2140b51ffa845f73fec0e.gif

 Wander Stars: Follow the story of Ringo and Wolfe as they join forces to collect the pieces of the Wanderstar Map in this turn-based RPG with roguelite elements! Use words to create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in an adventure inspired by 90s anime.
 Scrabdackle: As a novice wizard, discover the intricate world of Scrabdackle and experience the impact wizardkind has unknowingly had upon it. Scrabdackle is a hand-drawn, non-linear adventure with a vast, intricate overworld, tight and responsive combat, cheeky banter, and pages of lore to discover.
 Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo: A 3D adventure where you play as Kulebra, a dead snake with a heart of gold that wakes up in Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.So get exploring and grab some great narrative games!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238001/08bd399b820db34ab9715984ebab19df7c24f4b9.png

Players looking to say up to date with Citizen Sleeper and its upcoming sequel should sign-up for the Citizen Sleeper newsletter - not only will you get updates on the games and other things like merch, but you'll also receive the Helion Dispatches, a monthly series of text-based narrative transmissions from the refugee ship, the Pilgrim Seed, which flesh out the wider lore of Citizen Sleeper, set up the narrative for the sequel and bridge the gap between the two games.
